title: Rails
description: Requests, views, cache and database, from the Rails metrics that Rails Semantic Logger records.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName

panels.title: Request rate by status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(substring(Attributes['http.response.status_code'], 1, 1), 'xx') AS status, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, status
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Requests per second, from http.server.request.duration, by status class.

panels.title: Request latency

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p95, q[3] AS p99
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
         quantilesExactWeighted(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) AS q
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND c > 0
  GROUP BY time
)
ORDER BY time

panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 of http.server.request.duration: the whole request, middleware included.

panels.title: Server errors

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
       sumIf(Count, Attributes['error.type'] != '') / sum(Count) AS error_ratio
FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Share of requests with error.type set: a 5xx response, or an exception that escaped.

panels.title: Slowest routes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(Attributes['http.request.method'], ' ', Attributes['http.route']) AS route,
       sumIf(Count, i = 1) AS calls,
       round(quantileExactWeighted(0.95)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) * 1000, 1) AS p95_ms,
       round(sumIf(Sum, i = 1) / sumIf(Count, i = 1) * 1000, 1) AS mean_ms
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes, PositiveOffset, Scale, Count, Sum, c, i FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND Attributes['http.route'] != ''
)
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Routes by p95 of http.server.request.duration. Requests that matched no route are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Attributes['code.function.name'] AS action,
       sumIf(Count, i = 1) AS calls,
       round(quantileExactWeighted(0.95)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) * 1000, 1) AS p95_ms,
       round(sumIf(Sum, i = 1) / sumIf(Count, i = 1) * 1000, 1) AS mean_ms
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes, PositiveOffset, Scale, Count, Sum, c, i FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'rails.action_controller.process_action.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
)
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT time, kind, q[1] AS p95
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['rails.action_view.render.kind'] AS kind,
         quantilesExactWeighted(0.95)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) AS q
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'rails.action_view.render.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND c > 0
  GROUP BY time, kind
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
       if(Attributes['rails.cache.hit'] = 'true', 'hit', 'miss') AS result,
       sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS reads
FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'rails.cache.operation.duration' AND Attributes['rails.cache.operation.name'] = 'read'
  AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, result
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Cache reads per second from rails.cache.operation.duration, hits against misses.

panels.title: Queries by operation

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['db.operation.name'] AS operation, sum(Count) / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'db.client.operation.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, operation
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Queries per second from db.client.operation.duration. Cached and schema queries are not counted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, operation, q[1] AS p95
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['db.operation.name'] AS operation,
         quantilesExactWeighted(0.95)(pow(2, (PositiveOffset + i - 1 + 0.5) * pow(2, -Scale)), c) AS q
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_exponential_histogram
  ARRAY JOIN PositiveBucketCounts AS c, arrayEnumerate(PositiveBucketCounts) AS i
  WHERE MetricName = 'db.client.operation.duration' AND ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND c > 0
  GROUP BY time, operation
)
ORDER BY time
